research_question: Do coarse tactic-family sequences recur and predict across source and top-module boundaries in a revision-bound programme-scale Mathlib sample beyond structure-preserving nulls?

source.selection: Up to 16 paths per active top-level Mathlib module, ranked by sha256(path + NUL + ORION-P10-MATHLIB-V2); Deprecated and Testing excluded; no tactic content or outcome used.

projection.unit: tactic-mode theorem/lemma trajectory conservatively recognized after an explicit by opener
projection.actions: The 16 frozen coarse families in TACTIC_FAMILIES; consecutive duplicates collapsed; unknown and unclassified lines retained in source but excluded from sequences.
projection.nonclaim: This is a source-text projection, not a Lean grammar, proof-state trace, semantic tactic identity or kernel execution trace.

splits.leave_source_out: Train on every selected file except one and pool held-out transitions.
splits.leave_top_module_out: Train on all selected top-level Mathlib modules except one and pool the held-out module transitions.
splits.leakage_barrier: A held-out file or top module contributes no sequence, transition count or fallback statistic to its trained predictor.

systems.FIRST_ORDER_MARKOV: Training-split most-frequent next action conditioned on the current action, with UNIGRAM fallback.
systems.SEEN_NGRAM: Whether a held-out bigram/trigram was observed in the training split.

statistics.cross_module_macro: A unique n-gram occurring in at least two theorem trajectories and at least two top-level modules.
statistics.order_null: Independently permute each trajectory's actions, preserving trajectory length and action multiset; recompute cross-module macro counts.
statistics.provenance_null: Keep every trajectory sequence fixed and permute top-module labels across trajectories, preserving the observed label multiset; recompute cross-module macro counts.
statistics.p_values: Add-one empirical upper and lower tails plus two-sided 2*min(tails), capped at one.
statistics.blocked_interval: Top-module bootstrap 95% interval with 10000 resamples for the pooled FIRST_ORDER_MARKOV minus UNIGRAM accuracy difference.

metrics: recognized files, trajectories, projected actions and excluded unknown-line count
leave-source-out and leave-top-module-out bigram/trigram seen coverage
FIRST_ORDER_MARKOV and UNIGRAM next-action accuracy with paired difference
cross-module bigram/trigram macro count under both nulls and all seeds
provenance audit for every retained macro
standalone_decision_rule: KEEP_STANDALONE_P10 only if the leave-top-module-out Markov-minus-unigram improvement is at least 0.05 with a module-bootstrap 95% interval strictly above zero, an order statistic is significant at two-sided p<=0.01 under every frozen seed and both null families, native Lean verification receipts bind the corpus revision, and a distinct integrity residual survives nearest-work/ownership pressure. Otherwise TECHNICAL_NOTE_OR_MERGE_P10.

native_verification.receipt_subject: selected file path, file sha256, Mathlib commit, Lean toolchain, verifier command, exit status and stdout/stderr sha256
negative_controls: source revision substitution invalidates receipt subject binding
native rejection cannot be recorded as SUCCESS

nonclaims: No theorem correctness, tactic semantic equivalence, proof-search, prover superiority, Mathlib-wide transfer, autoformalization or scientific authority claim.
A content hash establishes identity only; native Lean acceptance and external authority remain separate receipts.
Failure to reject a null is not evidence that sequences are random or equivalent to the null.
reopen_triggers: Any selected source digest, Mathlib revision, Lean toolchain or parser definition changes.
A Lean-native trace representation reverses the source-projection result.
Repository/source-level blocking reverses an instance-level conclusion.
Nearest work absorbs the proposed content-binding integrity residual.
